learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to understand the scientific fundamentals of physics and transfer them to applications in mechatronics.

Students understand the influence of atomic bonding and material structure on mechanical, physical, and optical properties. Additionally, students are able to apply knowledge about diffusion, phase diagrams, and heat treatments to manufacturing and processing methods as well as damage cases.
Students possess advanced knowledge of the most important processes in manufacturing technology.

syllabus_topics: Accompanying exercises for the lecture with special consideration of mechatronics
Influence of atomic bonding and structure (crystalline, amorphous materials, dislocations, phases, microstructure etc.) on material properties
Thermally Activated Processes (Diffusion, Recovery, Recrystallization, Reaction Kinetics)
Methods for material-removing and material-forming shaping
Application areas and implementation in machine tools (WZM)
Programming of machine tools (CNC and CAD/CAM)
